title: Next-Action Trainer
description: Two-mode trainer for formulating real next actions: judge mode with test-naming feedback on four candidates per stalled task, and build mode with forgiving heuristic checks (verb-first, specificity, project-smell) plus and-after-that chain practice.
creator: Arun Batchu
subject: ADHD
Task Initiation
Task Breakdown
Productivity Systems
audience: People with ADHD, Family members, Students
